title: The part number's hover still shows Inventory or the vendor bill
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with an inventory part and a special-order part received on a vendor bill.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Point at the inventory part's part number.
  3. Point at the special-order part's part number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The hover reads "Inventory" as today.

Step 3:

  • The hover reads the vendor's name, " - " and the vendor bill number, as today.
